## What is Google Ads Coaching? Your shortcut to Google Ads Success

**All Google Ads practitioners can benefit from a professional “second set of eyes.” Here’s why I’m the industry’s go-to Google Ads Coach.**

#### 1\. You Get an "Insider" Strategy (Not Just Best Practices)

Most Google Ads experts have to guess how the algorithm works. _I don't._ As the only Google Ads Coach who actually worked at Google, I have a unique insider perspective on how to work with the system, rather than fighting against it, to drive the best results. And I'm still a trusted Google insider; I get to test new features like AI Max and Ads Advisor before the public sees them.

That means **you get proven strategies**, tailored to your account, backed by more than a decade of expertise. **A true competitive edge** over other advertisers who are just guessing.

#### 2\. You Save Money Through "Pattern Recognition"

**I see more accounts in a month than most people see in a year.** I don't coach "on the side." I am a full-time Google Ads Coach & teacher who has guided more than 400 clients through _one thousand_ coaching calls since 2021. I see the entire ecosystem, from $10 local budgets to $1M global spends, ecommerce and lead generation, B2B and B2C. I have developed a deep pattern recognition for what breaks in Google Ads, allowing me to spot and fix mistakes that most practitioners never encounter in their entire careers.

That means **you avoid expensive “learning” mistakes**. Goodbye wasted ad spend, goodbye trial and error, hello fast track to success.

#### 3\. You Get a Partner, Not a Competitor

I have zero interest in poaching your clients or taking over your ad spend, because **I don't run an agency or manage campaigns**. I'm proudly "just" a Google Ads Coach, which means I’m 100% neutral and unbiased.

**For Agencies:** That means I’m a trusted, "behind the scenes" partner who **makes you look like a hero** to your clients.

**For Business Owners:** That means I have no incentive to upsell you on management fees. **I just want you to win.**

[Let's hop on a call together](https://calendly.com/jyllsg/coaching)

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **"What is a Google Ads coaching call?"**

Your Google Ads coaching session is a 1-hour video call with me, a Google Ads Expert with more than a decade of experience. During the call, you can share your screen with me, and we'll meet your objectives together, whether that's setting up a campaign, optimizing the account, working on your strategy, etc. 

After the call, you'll receive a meeting recording, and an AI-generated transcript of our conversation.

To get a better idea of what to expect, check out [this video about a day in the life of a Google Ads coach](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gvv9aQ2S0g8) or [this video about what to expect during a 1-hour Google Ads coaching call](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q4NJl-qSaL4).

#### **“Can you solve my problem? What’s your track record? What are your credentials?"**

While I can’t guarantee that I can solve your Google Ads problems, I’ve got a pretty good track record at guiding business owners, marketers, agencies and freelancers through their toughest ads challenges. Since I began offering Google Ads coaching in 2021, I’ve been hired for more than 1,000 coaching calls with 400+ different clients. Before that, I worked at Google for 6 years and consulted on more than 10,000 different Google Ads accounts. I’ve really seen it all - all industries, all practitioner levels, every possible issue you can imagine (and more that you can’t even imagine).

# Google Ads Coach

Google Ads Coach[Sheldon Payne](https://sheldonpayne.com/author/sheldon-payne/)2026-06-25T09:54:43-03:30

## **1-on-1 Google Ads Coach**

Are you looking to get more from your Google Ads Account? I provide 1-on-1 Google Ads Coaching so you can convert more and improve your bottom line.

[Schedule A Free 30-Minute Discovery Call](https://sheldonpayne.com/contact/)

## Are you feeling like you’re in a constant battle with Google Ads, struggling to see the returns you envisioned?

It’s a common challenge, but it doesn’t have to be yours. I’m Sheldon Payne, a seasoned digital marketing expert, but this isn’t about me – it’s about you. You are the business owner, the marketer, the one on the front lines pushing your brand to succeed. I’m here to equip you with the tools, knowledge, and confidence to master Google Ads. Together, we will transform your campaigns from cost centers into profit engines, making you the hero in your business story.

![Sheldon - Google Ads Consultant](https://sheldonpayne.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Sheldon-Hey-Orca-107-scaled.jpg "Sheldon – Google Ads Consultant")

## **Who Should Get My Google Ads Coaching?**

I coach marketers and business owners who know the mechanics of the Google Ads platform but are not getting the results they need to move their business forward.

My typical coaching client will fall into one of 3 categories:

The **New Business Owner**

You have are just getting started with your business and you have recommended using Google Ads to grow your business. You have taken an online course or watched tutorials but are still not getting the results or spending too much money.

The **New Marketer**

You are just starting your career in marketing and you have to wear many hats with your current role. You have tried to learn Google Ads but have not had the results your boss is expecting to get from the work you are doing.

**In House Marketing Teams**

You have hired a marketing team to drive digital marketing results for your business. You know it’s important to use Google Ads to grow but not sure where to start. I work with Marketing teams to develop their paid media campaign strategy. I coach the team to save money and time to get the results of the business forward.

## **Meet Your  Coach – Sheldon Payne**

A Certified Google Ads Professional, I have been providing Small, Medium and Fortune 100 companies with forward-thinking digital marketing campaigns for over 19 years.

Prior to starting my own digital marketing agency in 2012 called [Newfound Marketing](https://www.newfoundmarketing.ca/service/), I was the Digital Marketing Director for M5 Communications (Ad Agency). Over the course of my careers, I have spent time in Montreal (Software Company) and London (Ad Agency) where I’ve planned and delivered sound Digital Marketing strategies to Fortune 100 clients. This included Hewlett Packard and Chevrolet Europe as part of their overall search marketing strategy while working with Zenith Optimedia (Part of Publicis Media).

![Google Ads Coach - Sheldon Payne](https://sheldonpayne.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/Sheldon-Profile-T-Shirt-Digital-Marketing-Coach.jpeg "Sheldon Payne Digital Marketing Coach")

Today, new customer acquisition is one of the greatest challenges for digital businesses. Fortunately, Google Ads can be an excellent tool for growing your business. But to do this, it helps to understand [how to run a cost-effective Google Ads](https://sheldonpayne.com/learn-how-to-develop-a-google-ads-strategy-that-drives-results-like-an-expert/) marketing campaign with a strong ROI.

My personalized private Google Adwords coaching assists you or your team in laying the groundwork for a successful campaign. If you are just getting started with Google Ads, this is the coaching for you!

You will leave with a better understanding of how the Google Ads system works, how campaigns should be structured, and finally, how keyword lists and ads are developed.

## **How Does My Google Ads Coaching Work?**

My coaching will start with a 30 minute discovery call via Zoom. During our call, I will meet with you and/or your team to discuss your current challenges. Based on the outcome of this will we will set a plan in place to work on any of the following areas to improve your current results.

*   Campaign Set-Up
*   Conversion Tracking
*   Campaign Structure
*   Keyword Research
*   Location targeting
*   Navigating through the Google Ads user interface
*   Developing quality keyword lists
*   Understanding keyword match types
*   Adding negative keywords
*   Writing compelling ad copy
*   Developing ad variations
*   The understanding campaign, ad group and keyword statistics
*   Tracking performance with Google Analytics

# My objectives as your coach are to help you:

**Understand and optimize your Google Ads campaigns**: Gain a deeper understanding of how Google Ads works, including keyword selection, bidding strategies, ad copywriting, and more. Learn how to analyze and optimize your campaigns for improved performance and ROI.

**Address challenges in your Google Ads strategy**: Identify the challenges and obstacles you’re currently facing in your Google Ads campaigns, such as low click-through rates, high costs per click, or low conversion rates. Develop strategies to overcome these challenges and improve your campaign performance.

**Leverage your strengths and improve your Google Ads proficiency**: Build on your existing knowledge and skills in digital marketing, and enhance your proficiency in specific areas of Google Ads that may be challenging. This could include areas like conversion tracking, ad scheduling, or advanced bidding strategies.

**Achieve your Google Ads goals and objectives**: Set clear, measurable goals for your Google Ads campaigns, such as increasing website traffic, boosting conversion rates, or reducing cost per acquisition. Learn how to effectively track and measure your progress towards these goals, and adjust your strategies as needed to ensure you’re on track to achieve them.
